mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `stock_score_daily` s LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = s.`code` AND i.`exchange` = s.`market`

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.`total_score` DESC, s.`code` ASC) AS `rank`, s.`code`, i.`name`, i.`market`, i.`exchange`, i.`board`, i.`industry`, s.`trade_date` AS `tradeDate`, s.`adjustflag` AS `adjustFlag`, s.`total_score` AS `totalScore`, s.`value_score` AS `valueScore`, s.`momentum_score` AS `momentumScore`, s.`trend_score` AS `trendScore`, s.`risk_score` AS `riskScore`, s.`liquidity_score` AS `liquidityScore`, s.`close`, s.`pe_ttm` AS `peTtm`, s.`pb_mrq` AS `pbMrq`, s.`ps_ttm` AS `psTtm`, s.`pcf_ncf_ttm` AS `pcfNcfTtm`, s.`ret_21` AS `ret21`, s.`ret_63` AS `ret63`, s.`ret_126` AS `ret126`, s.`ret_252` AS `ret252`, s.`vol_60` AS `vol60`, s.`drawdown_252` AS `drawdown252`, s.`amount_ratio_20` AS `amountRatio20`, s.`turnover_20` AS `turnover20` FROM `stock_score_daily` s LEFT JOIN `stock_info` i ON i.`code` = s.`code` AND i.`exchange` = s.`market`
ORDER BY s.`total_score` DESC, s.`code` ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT `trade_date` FROM `stock_score_daily` WHERE `adjustflag` = #{adjustFlag} ORDER BY `trade_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
